source_diagnostics.trigger: A constructor reads a stored-field subtree whose mask state is not Live.
A reachable second initialization targets a let FieldSlotId.
A constructor CFG join cannot prove the required slot Live on every incoming path.
COMMIT_READY contains a required Uninitialized, Moved, or MaybeMoved slot.
PrepublicationSelf crosses a forbidden storage, return, capture, send, FFI, async, generator, or escaping-borrow boundary.
PrepublicationSelf is used for dynamic, witness, extension, actor-message, or unknown dispatch.

release_verifier_diagnostics.trigger: HirConstructionLifecyclePlan has a non-total, inconsistent, or non-atomic mask transition.
ConstructionTokenId or a CleanupTokenId is duplicated, leaked, or consumed more than once.
Abort or live cleanup differs from the exact reverse-acquisition and base-recursion contract.
A construction session publishes other than once on commit or zero times on abort.
